stances.summary: Defends Michigan election integrity and security
stances.quote:
Michigan’s elections are safe and secure, and any attempt to suggest otherwise is an attempt to take away Michiganders’ constitutional right to vote and invade their privacy.

I want to thank @MIAttyGen Nessel and @MichSoS Benson for standing up for the rights of Michigan voters.

stances.summary: Supports abortion rights and reproductive access
stances.quote: Four years ago, the Supreme Court stripped away women’s access to abortion and right to choose. It was a devastating setback that continues to harm women across the country. In Michigan, we proved that people come together to protect reproductive freedom by enshrining that right.

stances.summary: Opposes Republican Medicaid cuts, backs relief
stances.quote:
While DC republicans slash Medicaid and skyrocket premiums, in Michigan, we’re working to get families real relief. cbsnews.com/detroit/news/mic…

Link



Michigan wipes out $74 million in medical debt for 71,000 residents

On Monday, Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer announced the

stances.summary: Expands medical debt forgiveness program
stances.quote:
🚨 Big news, Michigan!

We’re erasing over $74 million in medical debt for over 72,000 Michiganders in the second round of medical debt forgiveness. Our partnership with @unduemeddebt means fewer Michigan families have to choose between buying groceries or paying medical bills.

stances.summary: Promotes men's health awareness and access
stances.quote: During Men’s Health Month, we must work to reduce stigma and break down barriers that keep our fathers, brothers, sons, and friends from getting the care they deserve. Change starts with honest conversations, education, and listening to the men in our lives.

stances.summary: Advocates for women-centered healthcare approach
stances.quote:
Women deserve informed care that acknowledges our specific needs.

It’s on all of us to bring women’s health to the forefront. Let’s build a Michigan where women’s health is led by honest conversations and reliable care.

Video

stances.summary: Backs tax cuts and family financial relief
stances.quote: More money kept in your pocket is more money for bills, childcare, and keeping food on the table. That’s why here in Michigan we are saving you money through free pre-K, expanded childcare assistance, and over $1 billion in tax cuts for seniors and working families.

stances.summary: Supports childcare costs and school meal assistance
stances.quote:
Every family knows the feeling of having tough conversations about finances.

That's why we've stayed focused on making a difference for your family: lowering child care costs, making school meals free, and cutting over $1 billion in taxes for our seniors and working families.

stances.summary: Partners with JPMorgan Chase for economic growth
stances.quote:
Yesterday, I gathered with JPMorgan Chase and innovation partners for the Michigan Resiliency Summit.
 
We’re proud to welcome JPMorgan Chase to Detroit to help us build on our work to grow our economy, secure the future, and compete to win on the global stage.

stances.summary: Celebrates job creation and business expansion
stances.quote:
I’m so excited to be here at the expansion of La Colombe Coffee.

This expansion will strengthen our agricultural industry while creating over 300 new jobs, $567 million in investments, and put more milk from Michigan dairy farmers in lattes all across the country!

stances.summary: Supports UAW workers' strike for better wages
stances.quote:
Prices are on the rise all around us. Michiganders deserve good wages to pay bills and keep food on the table. Today, UAW workers are on strike bargaining for better pay and stronger benefits.

I will always stand with the hardworking men and women of the UAW.

stances.summary: Promotes tax cuts and cost-of-living relief
stances.quote:
Right now, prices are rising on the essentials. Here in Michigan, we’ve made real progress to put more money in people’s pockets.

💰Cut over $1 billion in taxes
💰Cut taxes on tips, overtime, and social security
💰Delivered free pre-K and community college tuition-free

stances.summary: Positions Michigan as mobility and innovation leader
stances.quote:
Michigan’s been revolutionizing how we get around for over a century.

We’re #1 for mobility, electrification, and automotive R&D and we’re not stopping there. Michigan will keep building the future of mobility on land, in the air, and on our waters.

stances.summary: Expands advanced air and maritime mobility initiatives
stances.quote:
We put the world on wheels. Now, we’re working hard to expand our mobility capabilities with our Advanced Air Mobility Initiative and the Michigan Maritime Strategy.

Our progress is a reminder -- if you want to build the next big thing, come to Michigan.

stances.summary: Highlights Michigan's transportation leadership role
stances.quote: Today, I’m gathered with transportation and mobility leaders at the ITS America Conference & Expo. What better place than the Motor City to share innovative ideas and build on our long history as a leader and the #1 state for mobility, electrification, and automotive R&D.

stances.summary: Backs tuition-free community college guarantee
stances.quote: For high school grads, we’ve got you too. The Michigan Guarantee means you can go to community college tuition-free after graduation, saving you and your parents money while you build a pathway towards a good paying job.

stances.summary: Promotes tuition-free adult education reconnect program
stances.quote:
It’s never too late to reconnect with your dreams. If you’re looking for opportunity, signing up for a tuition-free education is simple:

1. Visit Michigan.gov/reconnect

2. Find a participating community college or skills center.

3. Start learning and earning!

Video

stances.summary: Supports free school breakfast and lunch programs
stances.quote:
1.4 million kids + 180 school days + 2 free meals a day = focused students and relieved parents.
 
Free breakfast and lunch is an equation for success. It helps kids stay focused in class while saving parents an extra $1,000 PER year, PER child.
 
Let’s make it permanent!

stances.summary: Advocates for permanent free school meals
stances.quote: Raise your hand if you want to make free school meals permanent ✋

stances.summary: Launches literacy initiative with bipartisan council
stances.quote:
Earlier this year, I set a clear goal: Every Child Reads. To support our long-term focus on literacy, I’m bringing leaders together to serve on our Every Child Reads Champions Council.
Literacy is a marathon, not a miracle. Our bipartisan work must continue after I leave office.

stances.summary: Honors Juneteenth and commits to equity progress
stances.quote:
Happy Juneteenth, Michigan!

However you choose to celebrate or recognize the day, let’s all take time to honor those who paved the way for progress, and recommit ourselves to building a more just, equitable Michigan and nation.

Video

stances.summary: Celebrates Black Michiganders' historical contributions
stances.quote:
Michigan’s story is incomplete without the legacy of Black Michiganders.
 
As we gear up to celebrate Juneteenth later this month, let's all take time to recognize and honor the countless contributions of Black Michiganders who have made our state what it is today.

stances.summary: Stops immigration detention facility operations
stances.quote:
I commend the efforts of Attorney General Nessel, Romulus Mayor McCraight, and our state and federal lawmakers for putting a stop to this facility.


Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel (@MIAttyGen)

The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Agency has decided to abandon its

stances.summary: Addresses housing shortage through zoning reform
stances.quote:
Right now, we face a housing shortage that is driving up costs and keeping families from their American Dream.
 
It's time for us to cut red tape, streamline zoning, and get shovels hitting dirt so we can build more homes and make housing affordable.

stances.summary: Completes bridge and road infrastructure repairs
stances.quote:
We got it done! Thank you to our partners at @michigandot, @waynecountymi, and all the hard working men and women who delivered for our state.

Let’s keep working together to fix bridges and roads all across Michigan. piped.video/zmR37JcXhcQ?si=9JSo…

stances.summary: Proposes affordable housing tax credit plan
stances.quote:
I proposed a plan during my State of the State to lower housing costs . The plan would unlock a new, state-level affordable housing tax credit, cut red tape, and streamline zoning.

Let’s build more homes and drive costs down so every Michigander can find a place to call home.

stances.summary: Reports completion of road and bridge fixes
stances.quote:
26,500 lane miles of road fixed
                        ➕
 Almost 2,000 bridges repaired
 _______________________________
 
🟰  Smoother, safer rides. 

This work is helping people get where they need to go safely and supporting tens of thousands of jobs along the way.

stances.summary: Celebrates Miller Rotunda Bridge reopening
stances.quote:
Seven years ago, this bridge was in rough shape. 500 temporary supports were holding up the bridge and all its traffic, including school buses full of kids, every single day. I vowed to do something about it.
 
I’m proud to make good on that promise. mlive.com/news/detroit/2026/…

stances.summary: Completes major road and bridge repair initiatives
stances.quote: By the end of this year, we will have fixed 26,500 lane miles of road and almost 2,000 bridges, making commutes safer, smoother, and more reliable all across Michigan while supporting tens of thousands of jobs.

stances.summary: Fulfills campaign promise to fix roads and bridges
stances.quote:
I ran on fixing the damn roads and bridges in communities across Michigan.
 
Today, I’m so excited to be at the reopening of the Miller Rotunda Bridge, a key piece of infrastructure that supports our economy and connects people to the heart of Dearborn.

stances.summary: Highlights economic and education accomplishments
stances.quote:
We're fixing the damn roads, bringing jobs home, investing in our kids, and working to lower costs for working families. We're not done yet. We'll keep delivering results and building opportunity for every Michigander.
 
I’m all gas, no brakes until my last day in office.

stances.summary: Empowers Mackinac Island residents on ferry decisions
stances.quote:
Mackinac Island is Michigan’s gem. For residents and the 1.2 million people who visit every year, the ferry service should be accessible and affordable.
 
Today, I signed a bill that empowers the people of Mackinac Island to make decisions about their economy.

stances.summary: Praises National Guard service and sacrifice
stances.quote:
The @MINationalGuard has been there for our communities during emergencies, natural disasters and overseas deployments, demonstrating professionalism, courage and selfless service.

Thank you to our Guard members and their families for their unwavering commitment and sacrifice.

stances.summary: Supports sustainable food education in schools
stances.quote:
North Muskegon Public Schools are turning free school meals into a hands-on learning experience through the Norse Villages program.

Powered by Michigan’s free breakfast and lunch, students are stepping into the world of sustainable food and making their own healthy smoothies.

V

stances.summary: Calls gun violence epidemic solvable
stances.quote:
Gun violence is an epidemic we can solve. When we focus on common sense solutions, we save lives.
We can and will build a safer tomorrow, together.

Video

stances.summary: Highlights gun violence prevention measures implemented
stances.quote:
I am proud of our progress:

✅Universal Background Checks
✅Safe storage requirements
✅Stronger red flag laws
✅Record investments in public safety
✅Establishing the first ever Gun Violence Prevention Task Force

We’ve got a lot done, but we can’t stop here.

stances.summary: Proposes additional gun safety regulations
stances.quote:
🔸Banning ghost guns
🔸Waiting periods for firearm purchases
🔸Stronger school safety
🔸Support for community intervention
🔸Better victim support services
🔸Improvements on safe firearm storage education
Let’s get this done and build a safer, brighter future for Michigan.

stances.summary: Signs executive order on gun violence prevention
stances.quote:
Last year the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force released a report with proven strategies to save more lives in Michigan.

Today, I'm signing an executive order to take focused action to make these recommendations a reality. Here's how we further protect our communities ⬇️

stances.summary: Decries guns as leading killer of youth
stances.quote:
In this country, and only in this country, guns are the #1 killer of young people. Michigan knows this pain all too well. We’ve seen it in in our schools and universities, places of worship and places of employment — we shouldn’t have to live like this.

We need action.

stances.summary: Celebrates LGBTQ+ protections and civil rights progress
stances.quote: Pride is personal for me as a mom, a friend, a leader, and a Michigander. From signing the Elliot-Larsen Civil Rights Act with my daughter by my side to banning state funds for conversion therapy and establishing the first-ever statewide LGBTQ+ commission, we've got a lot done.

stances.summary: Commits to protecting LGBTQ+ Michiganders from attacks
stances.quote:
While I'm proud of our work building a Michigan for all, we can't slow down. As the LGBTQ+ community faces attacks, I am all gas no brakes on protecting LGBTQ+ Michiganders.

This proclamation is a reminder of what we've achieved and a commitment to the work ahead.

stances.summary: Affirms Michigan welcomes and celebrates LGBTQ+ community
stances.quote:
Happy Pride 🏳️‍🌈

Michigan is a state for everyone. I will always stand beside the LGBTQ+ community and protect our neighbors, loved ones, and friends. To every LGBTQ+ Michigander, you are welcomed and celebrated here!

Video

stances.summary: Praises LGBTQ+ leaders as community contributors
stances.quote: Every day, LGBTQ+ Michiganders make a difference in their communities. They guide us towards a future where everyone can thrive. I’m grateful I could kick off Pride Month with LGBTQ+ leaders who inspire me to keep building a better, more inclusive Michigan.
